films.title: Distress
films.description: Disorder Skateboards' first full-length opens with Kwesi Holloway and closes with Nyjah Huston across 24 minutes of raw street skating. Directed and edited by Tim Cisilino, the 2025 film features the Disorder team alongside Mark Appleyard, Alex Midler and Toa Sasaki.

sourceRecords.sourceDetails: Public, embeddable complete film on Thrasher Magazine's authorized publishing channel; exact runtime 24:10 and upload date July 25, 2025.

Independent contemporary review reproduces Tim Cisilino's first-person statement that he directed and edited Disorder's first video, Distress.

films.title: Side Mission
films.description: Monster Energy's first full-length skate film grew from the team's summer 2022 European tour into a 40-minute mission through Bristol, Athens, Israel and beyond. Filmed by Daniel Galli, Side Mission features Nyjah Huston, Lizzie Armanto, Grant Taylor, Ishod Wair and twenty more Monster riders.

sourceRecords.sourceDetails: Public, embeddable complete film on Thrasher Magazine's authorized publishing channel; exact runtime 40:42 and upload date April 3, 2023.
